item.combinator.wormhole_gun.tip2: look. Sneak + right-click: an orange one.
item.combinator.wormhole_gun.tip3: What goes into one comes out of the other,
item.combinator.wormhole_gun.tip4: as fast as it went in. Even across worlds.
item.combinator.grave_compass.tip1: Right-click: you are taken to the spot
item.combinator.grave_compass.tip2: where you last died, in any world.
item.combinator.escape_rope.tip1: Right-click: straight up to the open sky,
item.combinator.escape_rope.tip2: from any cave. In the Nether: onto the roof.
item.combinator.elevator_pearl.tip1: Right-click: up through the ceiling to the
item.combinator.elevator_pearl.tip2: next floor above you. Sneak + right-click:
item.combinator.elevator_pearl.tip3: down through the floor to the next room.
item.combinator.friendship_bracelet.tip1: Right-click: you go to the nearest player,
item.combinator.friendship_bracelet.tip2: in any world. Sneak + right-click: the
item.combinator.wanderlust_atlas.tip2: blocks away in a random direction, onto
item.combinator.wanderlust_atlas.tip3: dry land if there is any. Adventure!
item.combinator.pet_whistle.tip1: Right-click: every tame animal of yours,
item.combinator.pet_whistle.tip2: wherever it is in a loaded place of any
item.combinator.blueprint.tip1: Right-click the ground: a real structure of
item.combinator.blueprint.tip2: the game is built there at once: a village,
item.combinator.blueprint.tip3: a mansion, an end city, an ancient city ...
item.combinator.biome_brush.tip1: Right-click: the land within 12 blocks of
item.combinator.biome_brush.tip2: the spot you look at becomes another biome:
item.combinator.biome_brush.tip3: colours, sky, weather and mobs. Sneak +
item.combinator.builder_wand.tip1: Right-click a block: every connected block
item.combinator.builder_wand.tip2: of that kind on that side grows one block
item.combinator.builder_wand.tip3: outwards. Up to 64 at once. Uses the blocks
item.combinator.rail_wand.tip2: long in the direction you face. Tunnels
item.combinator.rail_wand.tip3: through hills, a track bed over valleys.
item.combinator.rail_wand.tip4: You get into a minecart on it.
item.combinator.quarry_box.tip1: Right-click the ground: a pit of 11 x 11
item.combinator.quarry_box.tip2: blocks is dug down to the bedrock. Ores and
item.combinator.quarry_box.tip3: everything else worth keeping go into
item.combinator.quarry_box.tip4: chests at the edge. Stone and dirt do not.
item.combinator.sorting_wand.tip1: Sneak + right-click a chest: everything you
item.combinator.sorting_wand.tip2: carry that the chest already holds goes
item.combinator.sorting_wand.tip3: into it, then the chest is sorted.
item.combinator.ender_mail.tip1: Hold it, and something in the other hand.
item.combinator.ender_mail.tip2: Right-click: that stack flies to the
item.combinator.ender_mail.tip3: nearest player, in any world. Rename the
item.combinator.ender_mail.tip4: mail on an anvil to send it to that player.
item.combinator.lumen_orb.tip1: Right-click: an invisible light hangs over
item.combinator.lumen_orb.tip2: every dark floor within 24 blocks. Caves
item.combinator.lumen_orb.tip3: light up, and monsters cannot spawn there.
item.combinator.almond_water.tip1: Every bad effect goes away. Regeneration.
item.combinator.almond_water.tip2: Smilers nearby forget you. Lies around in
item.combinator.almond_water.tip3: the Backrooms. Can be drunk when full.
